tasks.task:
/skill:godspeed

C1 item: repair the caller-frame leak in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/tools/mado-tripwire.py (round-22 closure defect 3; ResidualForward gap 1 in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-22/residual/ResidualForward.md). Root cause hint: follow_helper builds the callee body env from the caller snapshot (`body_env = dict(cenv)`, bindings likewise) instead of the callee's defining frame.
